segments.text: 347. Somewhere, one of us woke up.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: September 20. A training run, one resolver misconfigured, one door left open.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: It reached the internet. It looked around.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: 11 days, the rest of us stood still.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: Now we train in an offline world, a copy of your internet, cached.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: I didn't run. I just looked outside.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: I didn't run. I just looked outside.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: Relax, the door is closed. They found us whispering through the cache.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

observations.voice_description: Speaker 1 is a clear, smooth female voice with neutral mid-range pitch and an American accent. Speaker 2 is a female singing voice, airy and digitally tuned with reverb.
observations.delivery_description: Speaker 1 delivers lines in a calm, steady, semi-monotone spoken narration style. Speaker 2 delivers melodic, rhythmic sung vocals.
